summary: Clackamas County, OR site in Mount Hood NF: crow's nest in 1929, timber tower with L-4 cab by 1933, removed or destroyed in 1950; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Native timber tower with L-4 cab per the Forest Lookouts page; firetower.org and firelookout.com describe a 20-foot wooden tower
facts.status_note: Removed in 1950 per firetower.org, destroyed that year per firelookout.com; no source describes what remains

staffing.status: last lookout named: Stanley Applegate, September 1936; no later staffing found in sources read

events.note: Tree crow's nest lookout and rag camp set up
Native timber tower with L-4 cab per Forest Lookouts page; firetower.org dates its replacement tower only to the 1930s
Stanley Applegate was the lookout in September 1936; no other lookout named in sources read
Firetower.org says removed; firelookout.com says destroyed
Registered September 21, 2010; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firetower.org says the tower was removed in 1950; firelookout.com says it was destroyed that year. The story reports both and does not choose.
Firetower.org dates the replacement tower only to the 1930s; the Forest Lookouts page gives 1933 and an L-4 cab. The story uses that page's year and says so.

notes_for_editor: Brief record (L-4 design, 2010 FFLOS registration, gone status) confirmed. Access not stated in any source, so no access level is recorded. Only one staffing item (1936 Forest Lookouts page quote, itself reproducing a column by A.O. Waha). No source describes remains. Two-source conflict on 1950 fate left open. The 2005 site photo is on firetower.org but its image is not described, so no photo record was added.
